title: Module derived restriction on injective section complexes
statement:
Let $u:T'\to T$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring. Use sheaves of modules over the constant sheaves $\Lambda_T,\Lambda_{T'}$ on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be the exact module inverse-image adjunction of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and compute derived direct image and derived sections within these module categories [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-kun-rgamma-unbounded]. Write $Q_T,Q_{T'},Q_\Lambda$ for localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $I,J$ be bounded-below complexes of injective module sheaves on $T,T'$ respectively [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $a:u^{-1}I\to J$ be any module-linear chain map. Let $e_{u,I}:\Gamma(T,I)\to\Gamma(T',u^{-1}I)$ be the degreewise adjunction-unit section map, using $\Gamma(T,u_*F)=\Gamma(T',F)$. Let $\alpha_I:Q_\Lambda\Gamma(T,I)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(T,Q_TI)$ and $\alpha_J:Q_\Lambda\Gamma(T',J)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(T',Q_{T'}J)$ be the canonical resolution comparisons. Identify $u^{-1}(Q_TI)$ with $Q_{T'}(u^{-1}I)$ by exactness, and define $\mathrm{res}_u:R\Gamma(T,Q_TI)\to R\Gamma(T',Q_{T'}u^{-1}I)$ as $R\Gamma$ of the derived adjunction unit followed by the canonical module Leray comparison $R\Gamma(T,Ru_*N)\cong R\Gamma(T',N)$. Then the following is an equality in $D(\operatorname{Mod}\Lambda)$:
$$R\Gamma(T',Q_{T'}a)\circ\mathrm{res}_u=\alpha_J\circ Q_\Lambda\bigl(\Gamma(T',a)\circ e_{u,I}\bigr)\circ\alpha_I^{-1}.$$
No quasi-isomorphism condition on $a$ and no finiteness condition on $u$ or $\Lambda$ is assumed.

proof.text: For additive functors F and G, prove private module_compUnit_app by expanding rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit. The inverse composition comparison on a representative is the identity, by its inverse-hom law and mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso_refl_hom_app. Prove private module_leray_fac: the composite derived unit followed by rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' is Qh of e followed by the H-derived unit. Apply rightDerivedNatTrans_app to the identity to identify the composition comparison, cancel its hom with its inverse, and apply rightDerivedNatTrans_app to e. Specialize F to module direct image, G to sections on T, H to sections on T', and e to lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso. This fixes the normalization of canonical Leray without choosing further resolutions.

Prove private module_restriction_fac for an exact-left-adjoint pair L adjoint to R, an isomorphism e:R followed by G isomorphic to H, and a homotopy-category object M. Naturality of Leray at the exact-inverse-image factorization moves that comparison before Leray. Mathlib Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app expands the derived unit. Naturality of the G-derived unit moves the ordinary unit before the derived comparisons. Apply module_leray_fac at L(M), then functoriality of Qh. This yields Qh of G(unit) followed by e and then the H-derived unit. No units are inverted in this generic identity.

proof.text: In private module_chain, work over abstract abelian categories and let K be the homotopy class of I. Apply module_restriction_fac at K, then postcompose both sides by H-derived of Q(a). Naturality of the H-derived unit at the homotopy class of a moves that arbitrary map before the comparison. Adjunction.mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient identifies the homotopy adjunction unit with its degreewise chain unit. The result is the quotient of the ordinary chain map v=G(unit) followed by e followed by H(a). Quotient-to-derived comparison maps are identities on representatives, identifying the homotopy exact-inverse-image factorization with the cochain factorization. Expand rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso on I and J and cancel the invertible G-derived unit at I. The remaining equation is the derived restriction formula with Q(v). No map a is inverted. The final theorem specializes module_chain to the scheme-site functors, avoiding repeated unfolding of their concrete derived-category constructions.

proof.text: By chain-map extensionality and naturality of Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections at the ordinary inverse-image adjunction unit, Gamma(unit) followed by lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso equals globalSectionsUpperStarMap in each degree. The given hw therefore identifies w with v. Substitute this equality in the quotient calculation of the preceding step and use the proved module_restriction_fac identity to finish. All coefficients, morphisms and hypotheses remain unchanged.
